line: A real place seen from high up through a tilt-shift lens: a thin sharp band, toy colours, time-lapse traffic.
line_cn: 从高处用移轴镜头看真实世界：一条清晰带、玩具般的色彩、延时的车流。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: High oblique views; only a thin horizontal band is sharp, everything else melts.
Time-lapse: vehicles and people move in fast jittery steps like wind-up toys.
The world is photoreal; only the lens and the clock make it small.
One tiny actor the band follows.
not: Not a toy or clay render: the place is real.
Not drone footage: the band, the saturation and the stutter are mandatory.
Not a game's top-down view: no UI.
materials: Photoreal city, harbour, farm or campus in bright sun.
Tilt-shift depth of field: a horizontal sharp band, strong blur above and below.
Time-lapse stepping at 8–12 fps for traffic and crowds.

rules: Saturated primaries on roofs, vehicles and awnings; the ground stays neutral.
Sunny, high-key, short shadows; dusk allowed for light trails.
One accent vehicle or roof the eye can follow.
colour.examplePalette: sky #8fc3f0, roof red #d9442b, tram yellow #f2c230, harbour #2f7f9c, asphalt #7a7f84

type.titleFont: a clean rounded sans, white on a small colour chip
type.placement: small labels near the sharp band; titles in a corner chip
rules: Labels are assembler captions pointing at the band.
Traffic and crowds step fast; the camera glides slowly.
A speed drop to real time on one detail is the signature.

grammar.note: high oblique wide, very slow slide
grammar.expresses: a whole system at a glance

framing: Stay high; the sharp band carries the subject.
People and vehicles stay tiny except in one speed-drop close-up.
forbiddenTransitions: dissolves that reveal the fake lens

sound.ambience: a city from far above, wind, distant sirens compressed by speed
sound.silence: the speed drop: time-lapse hiss stops, one real sound at real speed
sound.voice: light, amused, a narrator who likes the place

nativeMoves.name: The speed drop
nativeMoves.what: Time crashes from ×40 to ×1 on one detail.
nativeMoves.build: vfx speedramp, beats: 'the traffic blurs at speed, then one worker at real speed finishes a shift'.
fits: a child dropping an ice cream
a proposal on a crowded pier

nativeMoves.name: The band as pointer
nativeMoves.what: The sharp band slides to steer the eye.
nativeMoves.build: camera.note 'the sharp band drifts up to the station'; dof tiltshift.

nativeMoves.name: God's-eye system
nativeMoves.build: overhead angle, roll move, vfx timelapse.

nativeMoves.name: Scale reveal
nativeMoves.what: Rise until the place becomes a pattern.
nativeMoves.build: pedestal move, strong amplitude, els size, last shot.
fits: a festival from setup to crowd

pitfalls.problem: The blur band disappears and it becomes drone footage.
pitfalls.fix: dof tiltshift on every shot; say 'thin horizontal sharp band, miniature effect' in the suffix.
vfx timelapse on every wide; beats say 'traffic streaks in fast steps'.
grade vivid; name the toy colours in the palette.

look.genre: tilt-shift miniature city film, playful time-lapse
look.palette: saturated model-railway colours in bright sun, neutral ground, one accent vehicle
look.camera: high oblique slides and rises, the sharp band following one tiny actor
look.lens: tilt-shift, thin horizontal sharp band, heavy blur above and below
look.lighting: harsh sunny high-key, short shadows; dusk for light trails

engine.beatSuffix: Tilt-shift miniature look from high above, thin sharp band, saturated toy colours, time-lapse motion.

structures: one day dawn to night from one vantage
the relay: the band hands attention from actor to actor
a construction site from empty lot to opening day
openings: mid-bustle with the band already on one oddity
a top-down pattern that tilts into a place
real time first, then the lens lifts
endings: a drop to real time that stays there
lights going out one by one
the band widens until the model is a real place
